## Overview

LRPDID102 is the **wide-tau prior-sensitivity companion** to
[LRPDID02](../lrp-rli-did-002/). It is the same arm-by-wave model, the same data and the
same sampler settings, differing in exactly one thing: the prior on the single causal
coefficient.

| | LRPDID02 (reference) | LRPDID102 (this model) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| randomised t2 contrast $\tau_{t2}$ | $\mathcal{N}(0,\ 0.5)$ | $\mathcal{N}(0,\ 1)$ |
| $\text{arm\_gap}_{t3}$, $\beta_{\text{period}}$, all other terms | tier scale | tier scale — unchanged |
| everything else | — | identical |

## Why this model exists

The prior-critical review (#382, recommendation 3) found the letter-sound fit the
clearest case of a posterior sitting in its prior's **right tail**: under
$\tau_{t2} \sim \mathcal{N}(0, 0.5)$ the reference posterior median is ≈ 0.60 logits,
89% [0.20, 0.98], $P(>0) = 0.99$ — the data want a larger positive effect than the
zero-centred half-unit scale comfortably allows, and power-scaling flags a prior-data
conflict. The review reads this as mild **attenuation, not a false result**; this
companion tests exactly that with the wide end of the defensible
$\mathcal{N}(0, 0.75\text{–}1.0)$ range.

Only $\tau_{t2}$ moves. $\text{arm\_gap}_{t3}$ keeps the tier scale, so
$\delta_{\text{crossover}} = \tau_{t2} - \text{arm\_gap}_{t3}$ is **not** a comparison
target in this fit — its two legs are deliberately priced differently here. Per the
recommendation's scope note, the dose model
[LRPDID07](../lrp-rli-did-007/) has no $\tau_{t2}$ (its estimand is the observational
$\mu_{\text{dose}} \sim \mathcal{N}(0, 1)$, already on the wide scale, assigned no
causal status), so no dose companion exists.

## How to read the comparison

The two fits may be compared only when both current reporting traces pass the complete
automatic gate. If the reference $\tau_{t2}$ is genuinely data-dominated, the posterior
here should match it to within Monte-Carlo error. A materially larger median under the
wider prior confirms the reference estimate is prior-attenuated — to be read as
conservative, with this fit's interval quoted beside it.

_Sign convention and reading rules as LRPDID02:_ positive favours the intervention;
$\tau_{t2}$ is the clean randomised t2 contrast, `arm_gap_t1` a baseline-balance
quantity, `arm_gap_t3` the randomised early-start-versus-delayed-start schedule
contrast, and `delta_crossover` the change between the two randomised regime
contrasts, neither of them mechanism-identified.
